structs.name: CWeatherBillboardType
structs.comment: A `weatherBillboardType` of interface/mapitems.gfx: a billboard type (CBillboardType's keys and factory) with its own list of `textureFile`s, two quads and its own drawing, slots 6, 7, 31, 34, 35 and 37. The fields below +0x134 that come from CBillboardType (+0x98, +0xB8, +0xD4, +0xF0) are placed here because the record has no CBillboardType struct.
